memory_definition: Maximum observed benchmark JVM RSS from /proc PID stat at one second intervals, including startup/warmup/measurement/drain, excluding Maven. Includes colocated client, Master, mock workers and native memory. Not exact unique physical backing accounting. Heap used at GC is stored separately and is not continuously sampled live-set.
limits: Same frozen source as previous JVM experiments, not concurrent latest work-tree edits. No production code or startup configuration changed.
Synthetic loopback Master/Mock Worker benchmark. No GPU inference; NON_BATCH does not execute frontend fetch or actual worker delivery.

Harness retains full payloads/responses/received batches for correctness checks; growing rate/duration changes retained fixture data and allocation pressure, so a heap threshold is not directly transferable to production.

Each warmup and formal measurement is ten seconds. Repeats are kept, including failures. A candidate passing this benchmark does not establish production steady-state capacity or all concurrency correctness.
Formal SLO pass and whole-run allocation stalls are distinct. Failures before formal measurement have no P99, not zero latency.
Heap size is the sole runtime variable. No GC worker, SoftMaxHeapSize, OS THP/NUMA/huge-page configuration changes.
Startup measurements are single java -version launches for initialization, not service-ready latency or repeat medians.
No claim that a larger heap caused executor rejections without repeat and mechanism evidence; rejecting tasks is recorded separately from GC allocation stalls.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
export JAVA_HOME=/opt/flexlb-jdk21-20261002
export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"
export MAVEN_OPTS="-Xms512m -Xmx2g -Duser.home=/data0/luoli.hn/data0 -Dmaven.repo.local=/data0/luoli.hn/data0/.m2/repository"
unset JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS JDK_JAVA_OPTIONS _JAVA_OPTIONS || true
source_root=/data0/luoli.hn/data0/work/rtp_llm_4/github-opensource/.tmp/flexlb-gc-factorial-20261009
root=/data0/luoli.hn/data0/work/rtp_llm_4/github-opensource/.tmp/flexlb-heap-sweep-20261009
mkdir -p "$root"
cd "$root"
cp "$source_root/revision.txt" "$source_root/archive.sha256" "$source_root/source-manifest.sha256" "$root/"
cd "$source_root"
sha256sum --quiet -c source-manifest.sha256
cd "$root"
mkdir -p evidence
{ cat revision.txt; java -version; uname -a; getconf _NPROCESSORS_ONLN; cat /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.max 2>/dev/null || true; cat /sys/kernel/mm/transparent_hugepage/enabled; cat /sys/kernel/mm/transparent_hugepage/shmem_enabled; free -h; } > evidence/environment.txt 2>&1
flags_for() {
 case "$1" in
  h8) heap=8g;;
  h16) heap=16g;;
  h24) heap=24g;;
  h32) heap=32g;;
  h48) heap=48g;;
  h64) heap=64g;;
  h96) heap=96g;;
  h128) heap=128g;;
 esac
 flags='-XX:+UseZGC -XX:+ZGenerational -XX:+AlwaysPreTouch'
}
cd "$source_root/rtp_llm/flexlb"
run_case() {
 profile="$1"; mode="$2"; qps="$3"; repeat="$4"
 flags_for "$profile"
 out="$root/evidence/$profile/$mode-$qps-r$repeat"
 mkdir -p "$out"
 printf '%s\n' "-Xms$heap -Xmx$heap $flags" > "$out/flags.txt"
 decision=FIXED_WINDOW
 if [[ "$mode" == NON_BATCH ]]; then decision=SINGLE; fi
 python3 "$root/monitor.py" "$source_root" "$out/process.jsonl" "$out/monitor.stop" &
 monitor_pid=$!
 echo "START $profile $mode $qps repeat=$repeat $(date -Is)"
 code=0
 ./mvnw -B -P 'opensource,!internal,api-performance-regression' -pl flexlb-api -am \
  '-Dtest=MasterBatchEndToEndPerformanceTest#masterMeetsRateSloAcrossEngineScaleMatrix' \
  -DfailIfNoTests=false -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false \
  "-Dflexlb.perf.heap=$heap" \
  "-Dflexlb.perf.jvm-args=$flags -XX:+ExitOnOutOfMemoryError -Xlog:gc*,safepoint:file=$out/gc-%p.log:time,uptime,level,tags" \
  "-Dflexlb.perf.delivery-mode=$mode" "-Dflexlb.perf.decision-mode=$decision" \
  -Dflexlb.perf.engine-matrix-topologies=750x750 \
  "-Dflexlb.perf.engine-matrix-target-qps=$qps" \
  -Dflexlb.perf.engine-matrix-duration-ms=10000 \
  -Dflexlb.perf.engine-matrix-warmup-ms=10000 \
  -Dflexlb.perf.engine-matrix-warmup-requests-per-prefill=16 \
  -Dflexlb.perf.engine-matrix-min-qps-ratio=0.98 \
  -Dflexlb.perf.engine-matrix-max-server-p99-ms=50 \
  -Dflexlb.perf.engine-matrix-max-client-p99-ms=50 \
  -Dflexlb.perf.engine-matrix-max-batch-wait-p99-ms=50 \
  test > "$out/test.log" 2>&1 || code=$?
 touch "$out/monitor.stop"
 wait "$monitor_pid"
 printf '%s\n' "$code" > "$out/test.exit"
 awk '/FlexLB Master engine-scale E2E:|FlexLB Master traffic failure:|\[ERROR\]   Master|OutOfMemoryError|BUILD SUCCESS|BUILD FAILURE/' "$out/test.log"
 echo "END $profile $mode $qps repeat=$repeat exit=$code $(date -Is)"
}
while [[ $# -ge 4 ]]; do
 profile="$1"
 if [[ ! -f "$root/evidence/startup/$profile/1.json" ]]; then
  flags_for "$profile"
  mkdir -p "$root/evidence/startup/$profile"
  python3 "$root/startup.py" "$root/evidence/startup/$profile/1" java "-Xms$heap" "-Xmx$heap" $flags -XX:+PrintFlagsFinal -version
 fi
 run_case "$1" "$2" "$3" "$4"
 shift 4
done
cd "$source_root"
sha256sum --quiet -c source-manifest.sha256
printf 'done\n' > "$root/extra.done"

assessment.batch_20k: 24GiB minimum observed tested passing heap; two P99s34.333/27.788ms, RSS28.5/28.8GiB, no whole-run allocation stalls. 32GiB two P99s29.285/24.806ms, RSS36.9/36.6GiB, no stalls. Favor32GiB as conservative benchmark candidate,24GiB as memory-priority candidate.
assessment.non_batch_20k: 8GiB smallest tested passing heap; two P99s13.407/42.892ms, RSS10.0GiB, no whole-run stalls. 4GiB OOM. Candidate8GiB, no production stability claim.
assessment.large_heap: 128GiB BATCH20k failed warmup once and passed39.774ms once; all preserved. NON_BATCH20k fastest observed7.204ms atRSS130.4GiB. Neither proves large heap is preferable under memory/latency constraints.
assessment.pressure_40k: No pass among tested settings. 8GiB NON_BATCH OOM;16GiB NON_BATCH warmup rejected tasks and94 allocation stalls;32GiB NON_BATCH rejected tasks with0 allocation stalls;128GiB NON_BATCH formal P9991.582ms and0 allocation stalls.32GiB BATCH rejected tasks with2324 stalls. Memory pressure and executor overload are separate constraints.
assessment.scope: Heap suggestions apply only to this ten-second synthetic benchmark on frozen81b068f322 source. Production live-set, request sizes, steady-state duration and colocated/native memory must be measured separately; no production config changed.
